hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ ! -f "$d/.cosmos/cosmosw" ]; then g="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" && d="$(dirname "$g")"; fi; [ -f "$d/.cosmos/cosmosw" ] && exec python3 "$d/.cosmos/cosmosw" hook; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; set -- "$p"/*/.cosmos/cosmosw; [ -f "$1" ] || exit 0; e="$(cat)"; r=0; for w in "$@"; do printf "%s" "$e" | COSMOS_PARENT_SESSION=1 python3 "$w" hook; [ $? -eq 2 ] && r=2; done; exit $r
